text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa decrees the formation of a National Guard force to boost Bahrain's security.
- Conference urges joint Arab petrochemical projects, closer coordination on technological imports and international marketing.
- Gulf Air shareholders meet in Qatar on Wednesday to discuss raising capital.
- Gulf Arab states' four-member mediation committee holds first meeting in Riyadh to resolve territorial dispute between Bahrain and Qatar.
